employerProcess.description: 482 sponsorship can run across phases in parallel, so you do not need to wait for one step to fully close before starting the next.

phases.title: Eligibility & Role Assessment
bullets: Confirm the role is on the CSOL or relevant occupation list
Check sponsorship status and apply for SBS if needed
Match pre-screened candidates from our verified talent pool

phases.title: Sponsorship & Nomination
bullets: Lodge SBS application and DOHA registration
Submit nomination and SAF levy details
Lodge visa application with the nominated candidate

phases.title: Visa Grant & Ongoing Compliance
bullets: Employee starts work under sponsorship conditions
Track visa milestones and compliance obligations
